propositions: The retired trigger word 'recheck-review' collides with external CI ChatOps substring matcher for 'recheck' in gerrit_to_platform.ini, causing bot comments to cancel in-flight verified workflows and leave spurious Verified -1 labels.
The bot's own reply texts embed the retired trigger word verbatim, causing each bot-posted comment to re-dispatch the CI cancellation workflow.
Handler must accept 'rerun-llm-review' (new trigger) in place of 'recheck-review' (retired), with new word chosen to share no substring with any [mapping comment-added] key.
Retired-word comments must post exactly one refusal reply (after project guard and change re-anchoring) without enqueuing review or writing labels.
All bot-posted reply texts and contributor documentation must be scrubbed of retired word; retired word survives only in retrigger.py detector and test fixtures that exercise refusal branch.
Test suite must parse ini template at runtime to assert substring-safety in both directions and verify no bot replies contain mapped CI trigger words.
